name: Florianópolis
tagline: Island of 40 beaches, dunes and lagoons
summary: Florianópolis, or Floripa, is an island city with over 40 beaches, from surf breaks to calm bays. Sandboard the dunes of Joaquina, hike to Lagoinha do Leste, eat oysters at Ribeirão da Ilha and enjoy Lagoa da Conceição's restaurants and nightlife.
seasonNote: Summer (December to March) is beach season; winter is quiet and cool.
arrival: Hercílio Luz Airport is 20 minutes from the centre.
gettingAround: A car or Uber; island buses are slow.
cashTip: Cards and Pix are everywhere; carry a little cash for beach vendors and keep valuables out of sight.
foodTip: Fresh oysters and sequência de camarão.
buyTip: Lace from Santo Antônio de Lisboa.
